observations.text: The speaker repeatedly states that 'nobody cares' while simultaneously seeking validation and engagement from others.
observations.quote: Nobody cares. Make me care. That's the message. Stop assuming people care.

observations.quote: I'm not going to be a big giant racist. Now, was I mixing these two white women up? Absolutely.
